title: Partner in a perfect matching
statement: For a natural number $m$, a perfect matching of the complete graph on $2m$ vertices, and a vertex $v$ of that graph, define the partner of $v$ to be the vertex paired with $v$ by the matching.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching of the complete graph on $2m$ vertices
